thread:
maya: quick question — for the routing fallback work, how should we show a consumer what actually happened when we reroute to a cheaper model?

sven: short answer: expose a small, structured hint in the response and show a human-friendly badge in the console.

trish: agree. SDKs can map the hint to an enum. we should avoid exposing internal model names in the client. badge should say something like `fallback: policy` or `fallback: degraded` not `mistral-7b-qa`

jen: +1. also need a telemetry field so alerts can query "fallback rate by policy". maybe add `X-Redwood-Routing: policy=cost;variant=fallback` in headers? thoughts on header verbosity?

maya: headers fine, but prefer compact k/v: `X-RW-Routing: tier=best-effort;reason=capacity` — SDKs expand. console uses parsed fields. ops-bot: auto-note: new header proposed `X-RW-Routing` will be logged to request traces if enabled.

trish: we also need to show quota interactions: when a fallback is due to quota vs region vs model-compat. propose `reason=quota|region|compat|policy`

jen: UI copy question: telemetry-level reasons are fine, but what do we show to end-developers in the request details drawer? a single line + hover tooltip?

maya: single-line friendly phrase: e.g. "Routed to fallback (cost policy) — retryable" and tooltip with raw fields. avoid technical jargon on top-line.

nina: on logging side, we should emit both the routing header and a boolean `routed_to_fallback` to make dashboards cheaper to query.

sven: for status codes, do NOT invent new 2xx/4xx/5xx — keep HTTP semantics. use a small `rw_status` in body/headers for client-facing classification: `rw_status=transient|degraded|terminal`

trish: +1. that maps nicely to UX: transient -> retry hint, degraded -> quality warning, terminal -> actionable error with docs link.

jen: question about SDK behavior: should SDKs auto-surface a short retry_hint when rw_status=transient? that would simplify apps but might mask complex logic.

maya: make it opt-in default-off. we can enable in beta for our JS/Go SDKs. have an `auto_hints` config flag.

ops-bot: deploy note: added feature flag `routing-hints-v1` to staging for testing on monday.

trish: last thing — telemetry naming: standardize event names: `fallback.routed`, `fallback.reason.quota`, `fallback.policy.cost`. console dashboards will treat `fallback.routed` as primary metric.

nina: I'll add mapping to the telemetry catalog and a doc snippet for the console team.

maya: thanks — i'll draft a tiny RFC with header names, rw_status values, and example UI copy. aim to keep top-line consumer message non-technical but searchable by reason in console.

jen: sounds good. ping when RFC is up and i'll do a short UX review. :thumbsup:
